name: Candle of Beckoning
summary: On Brightwater Lake, Gunther Arcanus keeps an enchanted candle for a summons. Light it on a nearby islet, and the restless spirit Lillith Nefara answers.

sections.title: A Test of Allegiance
sections.body: Gunther Arcanus keeps the Candle of Beckoning in a crate beside him on his island in Brightwater Lake. The candle is an instrument for a ritual of summoning. Gunther is a fiercely independent undead sorcerer who broke free of the Lich King's command on his own, and he remains wary of both the Scourge and the Forsaken. To show Gunther that you are not loyal to the Lich King, carry one of the candles southwest to a smaller islet. Set it on an old, bloodstained table and light it. The flame pierces the veil between worlds and beckons the dormant, restless shade of Lillith Nefara, a powerful Scourge agent, so she can be destroyed.

faq.q: What is the Candle of Beckoning used for?
aliases: what does candle of beckoning do
how to use candle of beckoning
faq.answer: Light the Candle of Beckoning on the old, bloodstained ritual table on the smaller islet southwest of Gunther Arcanus's camp to summon the shade Lillith Nefara. The candle draws her dormant spirit into the physical realm.

faq.q: Where do you get the Candle of Beckoning?
aliases: where to find candle of beckoning
how to get candle of beckoning
faq.answer: You can take a Candle of Beckoning from a crate beside Gunther Arcanus on his island in Brightwater Lake, in eastern Tirisfal Glades, while undertaking his test of allegiance.

faq.q: Who is summoned by the candle?
faq.answer: Lighting the candle summons Lillith Nefara, a powerful Scourge agent who haunts the bloody altar off the island's southern coast. Defeating her proves that you do not serve the Scourge.

faq.q: Why does Gunther Arcanus have these candles?
faq.answer: Gunther uses the candles in a trial for anyone seeking his alliance. Fiercely protective of his autonomy from the Scourge and suspicious of outsiders, he demands that you face and destroy the restless dead he summons.

angles.text: For Forsaken emissaries sent by the Undercity, handling Gunther's ritual candle is a necessary step to convince the fiercely independent necromancer that you are not thralls of the Lich King.
As a mage, you can see Gunther's mastery of necromantic and conjuration arts in the way he binds spirits to ritual implements like this candle, outside the Kirin Tor's sanctioned teachings.
